name: GhostSpinner
description: Headless indeterminate loading indicator. useGhostSpinner owns status semantics and the live-region message; GhostSpinner is the thin unstyled element. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes. Loading-state orchestration stays with the consumer.

props.name: label
props.description: Status message rendered as visually hidden live-region content. role=status is nameFrom author; contents, not aria-label, are what polite AT announces.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The status span. Presence of the element is the pending state; there is no data-state.
